usedFor: SurveySparrow holds surveys and contacts, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command on your computer through “Trigger Command”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Survey” in SurveySparrow, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: Creating a survey is a clear starting point for local setup work, so the command runs on your machine.

watchOut: “New Survey” is polling, so “Trigger Command” starts after a scheduled check, not as the survey is made.
